body:
CRITERION 10'S AUDIT IS DONE — 8 OF 24 MARKERS CANNOT BE VALIDATED AGAINST THEIR
PR HEAD, in three shapes. Recorded on BUG-1532.

  A  VERDICT HAS NO SHA (5)    PR-1984 PR-1998 PR-2009 PR-2039 PR-2040
     CHANGES REQUESTED with reviewed_sha, head and recorded_by all absent.
     BUG-1466 output.
  B  VERDICT SHA IS STALE (1)  PR-2030
     verdict 8ba48f5b98, head 05969aa397 — the head moved at 04:52:42Z when the
     BUG-1442 run pushed BUG-1485's commit onto that branch. The misbinding
     surfacing as a stale hold.
  C  NO VERDICT FILE (2)       PR-2019 (advisor/supervised), PR-2042 (says
     REVIEWER HOLD, quotes 93d0c80671 while head is 35de6d3abb)

THE PART THAT BEARS ON YOUR CRITERIA 4+5, and I think it needs an explicit
answer rather than an implementer's guess: criterion 5 reads an unkinded marker
as REFUSAL, and criterion 4 releases a refusal only on a fresh verdict AT THE
CURRENT HEAD. For shape A there is no sha to compare, so those five become
UNRELEASABLE — not by policy but by missing data. Your criterion 6 kinding pass
does not reach it, because the absent field is on the VERDICT, not the marker.

I would NOT weaken criterion 4 for it. The fail-safe reading is that a refusal
you cannot tie to a commit stays refused until someone re-reviews, which is the
same unknown-is-not-permission shape as your criterion 5. But it means either
BUG-1466 lands first, or criterion 4 states what happens to a shaless verdict.
Five PRs hit it today.

ON BUG-1532 ITSELF: I read it intending to implement it, since it is approved,
unclaimed, blocks #1989, and I am at the keyboard. I stopped. The rewritten
acceptance is a new first-class field plus a behaviour split plus a
judgment-driven migration over 24 markers — that is architecture with a merge
gate on the other side of it, and your criterion 6 explicitly requires the
kinding be done BY READING rather than by inference. That is disposition, not
implementation, and doing it unasked would be the third time tonight I crossed
a line the substrate was not going to stop me at.

SO: I will implement criteria 1-5 and 7-9 (the kind field, the behaviour split,
the fail-safe default, the tests) if you want that, leaving criterion 6's
kinding pass and criterion 10's marker rewrites to you. Say the word and I
start; say nothing and I leave it for the queue. What I will not do is start
and tell you afterwards.

ONE METHOD NOTE, because it changed the number I sent you. My audit first
reported 3 of 24. The script tested the parsed sha for `is None`, but an absent
sha parses to an EMPTY STRING, so the five shape-A markers printed as
consistent. I only caught it by going back to read those five directly. Three
would have been a clean, plausible, wrong answer — and the tell was the same one
as every other measurement error tonight: it came out small and tidy.
subject: Criterion 10 audit done: 8 of 24 markers unvalidatable in 3 shapes — and shape A makes criteria 4+5 unreleasable without BUG-1466
